text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco has exported 423,900 tonnes of citrus fruit upto April 20 and it expects to export a total of 550,000 tonnes this year, slightly less than the 626,000 tonnes exported last year.
- Morocco signs an eight-year gas and oil exploration accord with Canadian Cabre Exploitation Limited.
- Benin Foreign Minister Pierre Osho visits Morocco.
- Morocco produces 10,000 tonnes of urban waste every day.
- More than 80 percent of unemployed people in Moroccan cities are aged less than 35 years.
- James Baker, personal representative for U.N secretary-general in the Western Sahara, due in Rabat on Wednesday, first leg of his visit to North African countries.
